gaps.description: PostgresBrandRegistryServiceFactory exists and is request-scoped, but production app composition still needs to bind the canonical SQLAlchemy session factory into app.state.brand_registry_service_factory. Until composed, registry routes fail closed with 503.

Current Asset upload lifecycle is Project-scoped. Brand-scoped Logo/Font/PDF upload, Asset picker, READY state and rights metadata UI are not yet implemented. Core UI only attaches exact existing Asset IDs.
Brand Guide PDF upload/extraction pipeline creation and proposal listing UI are not composed. Exact proposal review/publish is implemented once a cited proposal exists.
Exact RuleSet recovery by ID is implemented, but list/history/compare/rollback UX across all BrandRuleSet versions is not yet implemented.
Licensed font picker, rights display, role mapping, family/style/weight and CJK fallback management are incomplete. Publication rights checks remain server-authoritative and fail closed.
Brand Kit compliance preview against real Canvas/DesignIR observations and click-through violation navigation is not yet implemented. Frontend does not fake compliance from local fields.
Project brand_id binding is implemented, but explicit project policy for exact BrandRuleSet version versus follow-current and downstream run-freeze UX remains to be surfaced.

The page supports exact ?ruleset= recovery, but creating a draft still needs the final UI navigation update so a refresh automatically reopens that exact draft without manually adding the query parameter.
Browser/PostgreSQL E2E must cover Brand creation, stale Brand PATCH, Draft/Publish, Font rights denial, Guide review/publish and Project If-Match binding.
Hosted GitHub Actions with executed green steps remains required; preceding nodes are affected by a recurring zero-step runner/account infrastructure blocker.
